constraints: The parameter object's .host property is mandatory; all other properties are optional and default as documented (e.g. .port defaults to 993, .connectionTimeOut to 30s, .checkConnectionDelay to 300s).
The .accessTokenOAuth2 and .password properties are consumed for authentication but are not echoed back on the returned transporter object.
The defined connection/check timeouts should be kept lower than the mail server's own timeout, otherwise the client-side timeout has no effect.
_needsReview: The parameter object's nested shape (in particular the .listener sub-object with onMailCreated/onMailDeleted/onFlagsModified callback contracts, each with its own (transporter, event) signature and per-event-type event object properties) is richer than a single Parameter/TypeRef can express without a dedicated callbackContract/Layer-2 substructure; only documented as free-text constraints here rather than modeled structurally.
